title: UCC § 2-306 — output, requirements, exclusive dealings
summary: The chapter connects variable quantities with good faith and exclusive dealings with efforts obligations.
notes: Structural Polymer applies requirements-contract reasoning. The output problem tests cessation of production. The Wood notes compare the provision’s best-efforts wording to the court’s reasonable-efforts implication. The standalone section and comments (PDF page 351) and the Wood–Lucy contract (PDF page 697) are in the Contracts Selections on file, linked below.
